cells.name: E-10 clipstale clipped stale place · pointer
cells.line: no driver (REGISTRY §P5-7 item 6, C-E5 §4.3): scrolling the scroller while a mouse hold is down ends the hold in both engines, and clipping before the press lets the press scroll the box back, so the in-place pointer path inside a scroller is not reached; the keyboard cells above read the clipped place
